summary: Final update: registered the one still-unexplained observation of this run as a gap under its own investigation, so it has an owner instead of living only in counterevidence. The VerifyLeader finding is settled and independent of it, while two executions of the extended-window harness reported the demoted node's own configuration view as still holding a vote at setup, which no construction sampling that view together with its own log index reproduces. The run's three lines are otherwise complete and coherent: (1) VerifyLeader can be confirmed by a non-voter's acknowledgement, so a leader that has lost every other voter keeps reporting success for its whole configured lease, even after a competing leader exists and has committed writes its FSM never received - gap answered, two executions plus pre-window controls, claim asserted; (2) the suspected demotion-view lag was refuted across seven sampled runs and that question is closed; (3) LeadershipTransferToServer aimed at a non-voter reports success indistinguishable from a real handover while the sitting leadership is interrupted and a fresh election decides the outcome, bounded by the observed recovery - claim asserted, question explained. Knowledge was promoted for all three behaviours with their receipts, and no further experiment was submitted because the remaining allocation would not cover executing and interpreting another receipt.
